verdict.rationale: The evidence shows workflow automation: built-in Sales Flows, an automated sales cycle, and agents that handle repetitive tasks around the clock. One hands-on community report says a timed email was set up in Salesforce within minutes, which suggests time-based triggering. Nothing in the pack explicitly documents recurring scheduling of jobs or flows, so the story is only glancingly supported. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of recurring or cron-style schedules for flows or jobs, schedule management controls, and independent corroboration of recurring execution.
